verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an HTTP API and a Console CRUD API (statsig-docs-10, statsig-docs-11), and one tutorial has you check a gate live via the JavaScript SDK in the browser console (statsig-docs-24). That gives a reference plus one hands-on example. Nothing shows the API reference itself is interactive or has try-it/runnable requests, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404 (statsig-probe-2). Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer, runnable request examples in the reference, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
